item.title: Harness-Zero: Harness Distillation via Agent-as-Harness
item.description:
The research tackles the problem that agents perform best with specialised harnesses, but such harnesses are only useful at deployment and limit model portability. The authors built a distillation technique that trains a model to internalise the benefits of a domain‑specific harness, allowing the model to keep those gains without needing the harness at run time. The result is a general‑purpose agent that retains high performance while eliminating the need for external harness infrastructure.

IT Breakdown: If you manage cloud infrastructure for agent services, you can reduce operational overhead: 1) identify a high‑performance harness for your domain, 2) use the authors’ distillation script to train your model with that harness as guidance, 3) deploy the distilled model alone and remove the external harness from your runtime stack.

item.title: [News] GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Toward population-scale discovery with efficient pathology foundation models
item.description: Microsoft Research has announced GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash, two pathology foundation models that reduce computational demands while retaining performance. These advances enable larger-scale studies and broader exploration in medical imaging.

item.title: [News] Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
item.description: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 3.8 Live, a new version of its Gemini model featuring real‑time live avatar interactions. This update enables developers to embed lifelike AI avatars directly into applications and services.

item.title: [News] PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses
item.description: PrismML has released tiny language models designed to run on Qualcomm-powered smart glasses, enabling on-device AI processing without relying on cloud resources. This move aligns with the industry trend toward edge AI, allowing smarter, more responsive wearables.

item.title: [News] Automating coherent long-form video generation
item.description: Google AI has unveiled a new capability to automatically generate long‑form, coherent videos from text prompts. The technology leverages advanced generative models to create continuous, narrative‑style video content that can be used for marketing, training, or media production.

item.title: [News] Accelerating vision-language models with LFM2.5-VL-DSpark
item.description: Hugging Face has released LFM2.5-VL-DSpark, a new vision-language model optimized for accelerated inference on modern hardware. The model promises faster performance and lower latency for multimodal tasks.
